text.description_html:
LCN 2030 Series New Style Door Closer Hold Open Clip Assembly

This is the New Style door hold open clip assembly for LCN 2030 Series (LCN Pacer) Concealed Door Closer.

Also available other LCN Door Closer Parts

These hold open clips mount into the door closer track and is held in place with the (2) included set screws.
Must have LCN 2030-3034H hold open wheel and LCN 2030-3038 new style track.

*Sold Individually
